text: California mails a ballot to every active registered voter, whether or not they asked for one.
seenIn: a viral photo of a stack of ballots

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Vote by Mail
truthSource.oneLine: County elections officials mail a vote-by-mail ballot to all active registered voters.

lesson.tip: A photo of unrequested ballots looks alarming until you know every voter gets one. Before sharing “evidence,” ask what the normal process looks like.
